def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v0` with additional interactions."""
    a1, a2, a3, a4 = parameters[:4]
    b1, b2, b3 = parameters[4:]
    
    return a1 + a2 * gate_voltage_abs + a3 * drain_voltage_abs + \
           a4 * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs + \
           b1 * np.exp(b2 * gate_voltage_abs) + \
           b3 * np.exp(b2 * drain_voltage_abs)
